title: "Platform Architecture"
subtitle: "Architecture documentation and analyses"
toc: false
---

This site holds two kinds of writing, both kept as plain Markdown so they can
be read by people, published to Confluence and fed to language models without
conversion.

**[The architecture](architecture/index.qmd)** is the top-level description of
the platform. Some of its chapters are written by hand; others are generated
from the environment descriptions in `data/`, so they stay true as the
environments change. The whole thing is also available as a single
[PDF](architecture/complete.pdf).

**[Analyses](analyses.qmd)** are self-contained pieces of research or
proposed changes. Each is a folder, renders to a page here, and also to a PDF
and a Word document you can share on their own.
